name: Egypt Labor Law No. 14 of 2025 Art. 124 annual leave tier floors on Egyptian hr.LeaveAllocation

payload.rationale: Conjunctive Egypt Labor Law No. 14 of 2025 (effective 2025-09-01, Art. 124) overlay on Egyptian annual leave allocations (jurisdiction_code == 'EG', leave_kind == 'annual', starts_on >= 2025-09-01): prorated_initial requires 6 <= qualifying_service_months < 12 with exact proportional floor 15 * m / 12 (+7d hazardous/remote: 7.5/14.5 at 6m, 8.75/15.75 at 7m, 10/17 at 8m, 11.25/18.25 at 9m, 12.5/19.5 at 10m, 13.75/20.75 at 11m); first_year >= 15d (+7d = 22d); standard >= 21d (+7d = 28d); senior >= 30d (+7d = 37d); protected_disability >= 45d (+7d = 52d).

response.expression: (((((self.entitlement_tier == 'prorated_initial') and ((((((((self.qualifying_service_months ?? 0) == 6) and (self.hazardous_or_remote ? (self.allocated_days >= 14.5) : (self.allocated_days >= 7.5))) or (((self.qualifying_service_months ?? 0) == 7) and (self.hazardous_or_remote ? (self.allocated_days >= 15.75) : (self.allocated_days >= 8.75)))) or (((self.qualifying_service_months ?? 0) == 8) and (self.hazardous_or_remote ?
